entities.name: Lajla Mattsson Magga

entities.summary: Lajla Mattsson Magga is a Southern Sami teacher, children's writer and lexicographer. Married to fellow Sami linguist Ole Henrik Magga, she lives in Kautokeino Municipality in the far northern Norwegian county of Finnmark.
